output.reply: Thanks for the suggestion. A dark mode that follows your system setting would save you the manual switch each evening, and we have passed it to our product team.
Thanks for flagging this, Maria. We will check the two $9.99 charges dated the 3rd and follow up about the duplicate.
Yes, you can export your notes as Markdown files from the export options in the app settings. Choose Markdown as the format before you start, so you have a backup before you travel.

Thanks for reaching out. Because the reset link goes to your old inbox, we will help you update the email address on your account so you can sign in again. We will follow up shortly with the next steps.

Thanks for the details. Pasting tables from Google Sheets into notes used to work for you, so we are looking into why the columns now collapse into one line in Lumen web on Chrome 131. We will follow up once we have more information.
You can share a notebook by opening it and choosing Share in the top bar. Enter the email address of the person you want to invite and set their access level.

We're sorry about the $120 annual plan charge after your March cancellation. We've flagged it for our billing team to review against your confirmation email and will follow up as soon as we can. We can't promise a refund or a specific timeline until that review is complete.
We are sorry your whole team cannot reach Lumen right before your presentation. We are looking into the connection problem now and will share an update as soon as we know more.

We are sorry to hear about this and are treating it as a possible unauthorized access to your account. Please change your password and turn on two-factor authentication if you have not already, and we will review the login alert and the shared notebooks as soon as possible.

Thanks for reporting this. We are sorry the update is stopping you from opening your notes with PDF attachments before your exam. We are looking into the iOS crash and will follow up as soon as we have more information.
Thanks for your request. We will update your billing details and send you an invoice with Brandt Logistics GmbH and your VAT number. We will follow up once it is done.
Thanks for the report. The word count in the footer shows 0 for notes that contain only emoji, and we will look into it. Let us know if you notice anything else.

Thanks for the detailed request. A version history that shows who edited a note and when, including who removed a paragraph, is useful for teams, and we have passed it to our product team. We cannot promise a delivery date, but we will let you know if this changes.
Thanks for reporting this. Sync stuck on 'Syncing...' and search returning no results are both unexpected, and we are looking into them for your account. We will follow up as soon as we know more.

Thanks for these suggestions. We have noted your requests for pinning notes to the top of a notebook, a default font size setting, and a 60-day trash retention period. We will share them with the product team, but we cannot promise if or when they will be added.

Thanks for reaching out. You can change your display name in your account settings under Profile, and the new name should appear on your comments after you save. If your comments still show the old nickname after saving, let us know and we will take a closer look.

Thanks for your question. The weekly summary emails can be turned off in the notification or email settings, which you can find by opening Settings and looking for the email or notification section. If you cannot find the option there, reply and we will walk you through it.
Gracias por avisarnos. Revisaremos por qué no le llega el correo de restablecimiento de contraseña y su inicio de sesión. Le daremos seguimiento lo antes posible.

We are sorry about the lost meeting notes, and we understand how frustrating it is for this to happen twice. We are escalating your report to our engineering team so they can investigate what caused the empty note and the missing version history.
Thanks for the suggestion. We have passed your request for an Android widget to our product team.

Sorry about the repeated downtime on the mobile app, and we understand why this is frustrating. We are looking into the recurring Monday morning unavailability and will share an update as soon as we know more. If you can, please send us the time and the error message you saw so we can compare it with our logs.

Thank you for your detailed question. We are not able to confirm from here whether links, comments and edit history carry over when notes are moved or notebooks are merged, so please test with a copy of a small notebook first. If you share your workspace details, our team can check the exact behaviour for your account.
We are sorry for the disruption. We are investigating the 503 errors affecting your office and will share an update as soon as we know more.

Thanks for reaching out. We do not have details about a student discount to share here, so please check our pricing page for current offers. If you have questions about the Plus plan, we are happy to help.

Thanks for reporting both issues. We have noted the slow freeze when opening notebooks with more than 200 notes and the Ctrl+B shortcut inserting a literal 'b', and we will pass them to the desktop team. We will follow up if we need more details.
We are sorry you are locked out and that your two-factor device is broken. We will review your sign-in and two-factor recovery options and follow up with the next steps for verifying your identity.

Thanks for flagging this. We will check the $48 charge and why your account still shows the free plan, and we will look into your two teammates not seeing the shared notebooks. We will follow up soon.

Thanks for your interest in Lumen for your 200 employees. We have noted your need for Okta single sign-on (SAML) as a hard requirement, and we will pass it to our product team. We cannot confirm a roadmap date yet, but our sales team can talk through your security requirements and current options.
Thanks for letting us know the app is running slowly today. We are sorry for the trouble and will look into it. Could you tell us which device and browser or app version you are using?

Thanks for the details. Images showing as broken icons after an Evernote import is not expected behavior, and we will look into why the attachments did not come across. We will follow up on whether re-linking or re-importing is the right way to fix it.

Bonjour, merci pour votre message. Vous pouvez modifier votre carte bancaire dans la section de facturation de votre abonnement, accessible depuis les paramètres de votre compte. Si vous ne trouvez pas l'option, indiquez-nous quel appareil vous utilisez et nous vous guiderons.

Thanks for reaching out. Lumen does not have a built-in save-as-template option that I can confirm from your message, so I am not able to point you to a menu item. We will look into whether templates are supported and follow up with you.
Thanks for reporting this. We are sorry that your coworkers get a 404 page when they open the share link lumen.example/s/ab12, and we will look into why it fails. We will follow up once we know more.
We are sorry about the $480 charge on your card and the overdraft it caused. We are checking the charge against your $48 plan now and will follow up as soon as we have confirmed the details.

Thanks for reaching out. Deleting your account removes your account and the notes stored in it, and our help article on account deletion explains the details. If you tell us when you're ready, we can also walk you through the steps.
Thanks for the suggestion. Alphabetical sorting of notes is not available at the moment, and we have passed your request to our product team. We cannot promise if or when it will be added.
Thanks for reporting this. We are looking into the image upload failure, and text notes are not affected by what you described. We will follow up once we have more information.
Vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Wir kümmern uns um Ihre Rechnung für Mai und senden Ihnen das PDF so schnell wie möglich zu.
We are sorry you were charged again after cancelling. We will look into the charge made today on your account and follow up with you about it.

Sorry the spellcheck keeps underlining 'Lumen' in your notes. We have noted this so the team can look into it. Until then, you can add the word to your spellcheck dictionary if your device or browser offers that option.
Thanks for reporting this. Exact phrase search returning notes that do not contain the phrase is a problem, and we are looking into it. We will follow up once we have more information.

Thanks for asking about switching to annual billing. The exact timing of the new charge depends on your current plan, and our team can confirm how it applies to your account if you reply here. We are happy to help you make the change.

Thanks for your question about using two accounts on one phone. Our help center explains how to add and switch between accounts on your device. If you can't find what you need there, reply to this ticket and we will help you set up your work and personal accounts.

Thanks for your questions. Our team will confirm how to turn on offline mode and whether it works for notebooks shared with you by teammates. We will also confirm how much storage the Plus plan includes.
Thanks for the report. We are sorry the checkbox in your to-do note toggles when you scroll on Android app version 5.2.1. We are looking into it and will update you when we know more.

Thanks for asking. Account merging is listed under account settings, so you can check there first to see whether your old and new accounts can be combined. If it is not available for your accounts, our support team can help you move your notes.
Thanks for reaching out. Since your former admin has left, our team will need to verify your company and help move admin rights to a current member. We will follow up with the next steps shortly.

Thanks for reporting this. Every note showing twice in your notebook list is not something you need to fix yourself, so please hold off on deleting anything for now. We will look into the duplicate notes and follow up with you.
You can change your password in your account settings under Security. If you run into trouble, reply here and we will help you.
Buenos días. Puede cambiar el idioma en Ajustes de la aplicación, en la sección Idioma, y elegir English. Si no encuentra la opción, avísenos y le ayudaremos.

Thanks for the suggestion. Due dates for checklist items and a calendar view are useful for task tracking, and we have passed your request to the product team. We cannot promise if or when this will be added.

Sorry about the scare. Please check the Trash in the sidebar first, since recently deleted notebooks can often be restored from there. If the notebook is not in Trash, reply to this ticket and our team will look into it as soon as possible.

Thanks for reporting this. We are sorry that real-time collaboration is not showing your teammates' cursors and changes. We are looking into it, and we will share an update as soon as we know more.
